meta.name: pytest-asyncio-httpx-mocking
meta.description: When masking httpx.AsyncClient with unittest.mock in Pytest, AsyncMock must be used instead of MagicMock for async methods like post/get to prevent TypeError when awaited.

howto.what_en: When the user asks to write or debug tests using pytest and httpx.AsyncClient, Claude automatically uses AsyncMock to mock async methods like post/get, preventing TypeError and providing correct code examples.

say_en.text: Write a pytest test that mocks httpx.AsyncClient's post method.
Fix this TypeError: object MagicMock can't be used in 'await' expression.
